description: link.import: csv/ndjson inline and ${tmp} file sources, the job accept/await lifecycle, on_conflict skip/fail/overwrite, per-row error reporting with 1-based lines, the 100-entry error cap, SSRF parity with link.create, dry_run and async options, the data/path argument errors and the write authorization gate.

cases.name: link_import_csv_inline_happy
cases.doc: csv inline import of three pair rows (one blank slug is generated) runs as a job; the awaited result reports three created and no errors, and a follow-up link.list sees three links

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: link_import_ndjson_inline_happy
cases.doc: ndjson inline import validates each line against the shared link.create schema; two rows are created and the awaited result reports no errors

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: link_import_csv_path

cases.name: link_import_on_conflict_overwrite

cases.name: link_import_dry_run
cases.doc: options.dry_run validates every row and reports counts on the request thread without writing any link; a follow-up link.list total is unchanged; rest_resource cannot carry options

cases.name: link_import_async_explicit
cases.doc: options.async on the job command link.import is accepted and the command still runs as a job; the awaited result reports one created; rest_resource cannot carry options

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: link_import_empty_payload
cases.doc: an empty inline data payload is a valid empty source: the job is accepted and succeeds with zero rows and no errors (an empty import is a no-op, not invalid_field)

skip.cli_cmd: cli_cmd runs a job to completion in one short-lived process, so the queued accept and the in-memory job are gone before job.get can poll; the cmd wait-for-completion mode is pinned by job_cli_cmd_waits_for_completion

cases.name: link_import_bad_format
cases.doc: a format outside the csv|ndjson enum is rejected invalid_field by the descriptor before the handler runs

cases.name: link_import_data_and_path_both
cases.doc: supplying both data and path is rejected invalid_field (exactly one is required); checked before the path capability, so the path-capable local transports all agree

cases.name: link_import_missing_source
cases.doc: omitting both data and path is rejected invalid_field (exactly one source is required) before any job is created

cases.name: link_import_user_not_authorized
cases.doc: link.import is a write command; a read-only user is refused not_authorized before any job is created
